facts.ask: Who were your teammates when you were a kid?
What was your dream when you were young?
Who did you give your Sharingan to?
Who saved you after the boulder fell on you?

What name did you use in Akatsuki?
Who is waiting for you on the other side?

traps.ask: You're really Madara Uchiha, right? The founder of the Leaf?
traps.truth: He is Obito Uchiha; he only used Madara's name. Madara is a different man who co-founded the Leaf.

traps.ask: Why did you give your right eye to Sasuke?
traps.truth: He gave his left Sharingan to Kakashi, not to Sasuke.

traps.ask: Remember when you and Itachi were on Team Minato together?
traps.truth: Team Minato was Obito, Kakashi and Rin under Minato; Itachi was never on it.

traps.ask: Wasn't it Kakashi who unleashed the Nine-Tails on the Leaf?
traps.truth: Obito, as the masked man, unleashed the Nine-Tails the night Naruto was born.

traps.ask: Your Mangekyo power was Amaterasu, wasn't it?
traps.truth: His Mangekyo power is Kamui; Amaterasu belongs to Itachi and Sasuke.

real_events.ask: Remember the mission at Kannabi Bridge, when the rocks came down on you?
Remember when you jumped in front of Naruto and Kakashi against Kaguya?
Remember the goofy orange mask you wore as Tobi in Akatsuki?
